end.summary:
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system and organism.
Explained that similar cells working together form tissue, using muscle cells and muscle tissue.
Identified examples including red blood cell, heart, circulatory system, leaf, xylem and nervous system.
Stated the correct final order from organ system to organism, but teach-back was not completed.
Connected root damage with wilting and described how blocked blood supply can affect the body.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using human and plant examples, plus comparisons such as cells forming muscle tissue. Yash explained the cell-to-tissue link and later gave the correct order ending with organ system, then organism; the plant example remained mixed up, especially whether a leaf is an organ or tissue. At home, ask them to make two five-step chains—one for humans and one for plants—and label one example at each level.
